# Elemental magic (skill)

Description: Damage and Eitr usage when using Elemental magic.

# Introduction

Elemental magic is a skill related to Elemental magic weapon class.

## Effects

Higher skill level in elemental magic reduces the Eitr cost to attack down to -33% and increases damage and knockback up to +141%.
Dundr Eitr cost is not reduced by Elemental magic Skill.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

## Leveling up

The player gains xp when hitting a creature with a staff. The amount is dependent on the staff used.

• Name: Staff of Embers | Eitr Used: 35 | Experience gained per hit: 24 | col_4: 1xp

• Name: Staff of Frost | Eitr Used: 5 | Experience gained per hit: 3 | col_4: 0.2xp

• Name: Dundr | Eitr Used: 25 | Experience gained per hit: 25 | col_4: 12 x 0.1xp

• Name: Staff of the Wild | Eitr Used: 55 | Experience gained per hit: 37 | col_4: 1xp

• Name: Staff of Fracturing | Eitr Used: 30 | Experience gained per hit: 20 | col_4: 12 x 0.1xp
